qa.what_happened: During the final days of the study, I remained silent in accordance with the rules, observing the other prisoners who tried to comply with the guards' expectations. The constant warnings and expectations were intense, especially towards Prisoner 9320, who was clearly struggling with the role.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I played the role of Prisoner 8031 throughout the study, adhering to the rules and observing the dynamics between the prisoners and the guards.

qa.what_happened: Today, I observed a significant shift in Prisoner 9320's behavior. He seemed to fully understand the gravity of his actions and consistently complied with my instructions. However, I couldn't shake the feeling that something wasn't quite right, especially when his behavior was so compliant. It made me reflect on the true nature of our roles and the impact they have on individuals.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The experience has left me questioning the morality and effectiveness of such studies.

qa.what_happened: I've been dealing with the prisoners' silence and trying to maintain order through a series of verbal warnings. It feels like I'm pushing them to improve, but I can't shake the feeling that I might be losing myself in this role.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me. I had to make sure the study's rules were followed, even when it felt uncomfortable.

qa.what_happened: Today was a mix of warnings and compliance. The guards were persistent, reminding me of the importance of consistency and improvement. Despite the growing difficulty of staying silent, I made sure to follow their orders carefully.

The study was stopped early, and I, Prisoner 1842, had a private debrief with the lead researcher. He explained that the experiment was concluded due to the emotional distress evident among the participants, particularly myself. He expressed concern about the repetitive nature of the routine and the psychological impact it had.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that really was me, Prisoner 1842, participating in this study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, while some aspects might seem familiar, this particular study does not resemble any well-known psychological experiment. It appears to be a unique, albeit flawed, attempt at understanding prison dynamics through a highly controlled and possibly unethical scenario.

qa.what_happened: I've been reinforcing positive behavior with verbal warnings to all prisoners, but especially to Prisoner 9320. I've noticed some improvement, though I remain vigilant to ensure it remains consistent.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I carried out my duties as instructed, trying to maintain order and fairness.
